verdict.rationale: LobeHub docs explicitly describe an 'IM Gateway' ('Agents where you already chat') and a Messenger docs section covering Telegram, Slack, and Discord, so three of the five named messengers are documented. However there is no mention of WhatsApp or iMessage support anywhere in the evidence pack, so the story is only partially fulfilled. Missing for 10: WhatsApp integration, iMessage integration, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that the messenger gateway works as documented.
